# Hostile argument vectors for scripts/dnr/snapshot-program.sh. test-dnr-collect.sh runs each one in a working
# directory that holds the run directory incident_1 (made by rundir.sh new incident) and the symbolic link
# incident_2 (to incident_1), with RPC_URL=https://rpc.example.test/ in the environment and stand-ins for curl and
# solana on PATH.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...]. Each case prints
# nothing on stdout, calls no stand-in and changes nothing in the working directory.
2	snapshot-program.sh: refused: usage: snapshot-program.sh <program_id> incident_<n>	ProgTest11111111111111111111111111111111111
2	snapshot-program.sh: refused: usage: snapshot-program.sh <program_id> incident_<n>	ProgTest11111111111111111111111111111111111	incident_1	extra
2	snapshot-program.sh: refused: '-x' is not a base58 program id (32-44 characters of [1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z])	-x	incident_1
2	snapshot-program.sh: refused: '../../etc' is not a base58 program id (32-44 characters of [1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z])	../../etc	incident_1
2	snapshot-program.sh: refused: '0OIlProgTest111111111111111111111111111111' is not a base58 program id (32-44 characters of [1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z])	0OIlProgTest111111111111111111111111111111	incident_1
2	snapshot-program.sh: refused: 'ProgTest1111111111111111111111111111111111' does not decode to a 32-byte public key	ProgTest1111111111111111111111111111111111	incident_1
